name: Water caretaker
design: Broad-shouldered muscular mature female Yautja, cool slate hide, squared alien orbital ridges, four strong ivory mandibles, thick scalp tendrils in two low bundles. Sleeveless dark plum knee tunic with ochre sash, worn brown hip apron and practical wrist wraps. Carries a narrow bronze water canister with closed lid by a handle in one hand; other hand rests gently at hip. No liquid pouring or environment.
